definitions.warning_band_width: warning.offset_m - alert.offset_m; both directed normalizations are retained for each pair
definitions.signed_gap: Exact convex Minkowski difference: positive Euclidean separation; negative minimum translation to separate overlapping filled outer regions. Circle-circle equals center_distance-r1-r2. Polygon offsets remain analytic disks, not tessellated arcs.
definitions.intrusion_depth: max(0,-signed_gap(inner_layer,other_warning)); translational overlap depth. For containment this is not the deepest interior signed-distance point, nor an area/percentage.
definitions.bin_normalization: Overlap percentage = -warning_signed_gap / target_facility_warning_band_width. >50%; (0,50%]; nonnegative gaps [0,200]m; >200m. Negative ratio can exceed 100%.
definitions.entity_attribution: Only entity_id in saved rejection evidence or named retreat-clearance entries actually below their saved requirement (default original retreat 50m). Positive clearance map entries are not counted; draw payloads are not scanned. Unnamed failures stay unattributed.
definitions.counts: One local shape/connection retry or one group proposal, not one segment/member issue. Category flags are multi-label; fractions over rejected units need not sum to 1. Exclusive category signatures sum to the rejected total.
definitions.group_proposal_attribution: Only terminal rejection evidence; earlier recovered local failures do not cause the final proposal attribution. Shape-exhaustion evidence unions its 20 failed attempts.
definitions.local_shape_denominator: Every saved rejected local shape plus the accepted shape in each proposal that reached connection; each identified by skeleton/group/proposal/shape_attempt.
definitions.local_connection_limitation: All 5020 saved retries from the 502 connection-exhausted proposals are counted. Failed connection attempts recovered by successful connections are not saved in candidate_pool, so an all-actual-connection failure rate is unavailable. The observed subset rate of 1 is not a population estimate.
definitions.combination_denominator: Episode combinations are reported separately; same-target bearing/approach-ratio filters lack entity witnesses and cannot be mixed with group-proposal entity rates.
definitions.work_overlap: Strict positive interior overlap (clearance < -1e-6m) of saved-shape work_points polyline, or a dwell/terminal work point, with a non-target warning region. Boundary-only touch is separate. This is planned work geometry, not M1 measured work_mask or actual flight.
definitions.work_reconstruction: No RNG, draw_shape, route_group, candidate search, or simulation. Accepted transit/monitoring work is evaluated from saved direction/lateral/bend/radii/phase/span; other role work uses deterministic original shape equations with a fixed-value reader returning only the saved accepted parameters. Source module hashes are retained. Selected candidates are cross-checked against saved work_points_enu_m.
definitions.interpretation: Q2 is only three S1 families and unbalanced intents/roles. Pair-exposure rates are observational associations, not effects of map crowding; entity-less failures prevent exhaustive causal attribution. No global infeasibility or criterion change is inferred.
definitions.pair_exposure_denominator: One proposal or local shape attempt contributes once per non-target facility in its map. Numerator counts rejection evidence naming that paired facility; multi-facility units may contribute to multiple pairs. Nearest-pair rows instead assign one bin per unit.
definitions.gap_bin_comparison_limit: All four unordered Q2 facility pairs fall in overlap_gt_50pct for both normalizations. Other bins have zero Q2 exposure, so cross-bin comparison is unavailable. S1 maps outside Q2 supply no Q2 trial denominator.

policy_audit.M1_check: task_v07/criteria_labels.py:126-130; forbid levels > exclusion_max_layer.other_facilities (1); level 1 warning allowed, 2/3 prohibited
policy_audit.additional_planning_restrictions: Non-target warning is still relevant to collection/retreat endpoint clearance checks (50m) and related construction rules. This is distinct from forbidding work inside warning.

exceptions_and_unresolved: Initial read-only lookup used a wildcard as an explicit rg file and two nonexistent summary filenames; corrected by file discovery; no input changed.
Initial inventory assumed at least one rejected S1 map, but the registered source contains 300 accepted maps; removed that assumption.
Successful-connection local retry histories are not preserved in full-pool records; statistics explicitly identify this missing denominator.
Final report round-trip validation initially compared integer histogram keys with JSON string keys; normalized keys to strings before writing. No source data or statistics changed.

registered_runtime_comparison.explanation: Only construction.py differs (prior F2b); this analysis does not invoke draw_operation, precheck_operation, ingress_issues, or route construction. All work-equation modules and configuration match Q2 registration.

summary_zh: 登记源 S1 共 300 个 family；Q2 涉及其中 3 个 family、20 个骨架。
四个 Q2 设施对的预警外缘有符号间距为 -805.235、-1124.657、-1061.119、-1011.785 m；两向均超过各自预警环带宽度的 50%，并均有双向警戒区及保护区侵入。其余间距档无 Q2 样本。
组提案 7200 个，拒绝 1827 个；局部形态尝试 36069 次，拒绝 29975 次。实体类别按证据多标签归类，缺失实体证据者单列。
连接耗尽提案保留了 5020 次失败重试；成功连接之前的完整失败历史未保存，不能计算全部实际连接尝试失败率。
exclusion_policy 与 M1 允许作业段进入非目标预警区；禁止其警戒区及保护区。
通过整航线检查的 5373 个组候选中，3155 个规划作业段与非目标预警区有内部重叠，涉及 10662 条候选成员作业路径；并非实测 M1 work_mask。
32 个选中组、160 名成员的已有作业航点与恢复结果逐点一致。
